items.statement: The investigation preserves the supplied n=0,1,2 species identities, charge and multiplicity and binds validation to individual candidates.
items.expected: Per-object identity and electronic-state assignments are explicit and checked.

items.statement: Candidate minima and pathways are advanced only with object-specific structural/frequency/pathway validation or are transparently marked unvalidated.
items.expected: The report records validation evidence for each advanced candidate and bounded failures for missing validation.

items.statement: The computed chemistry should distinguish bare-hydronium PT from hydrated-hydronium channels in thermodynamic favorability and/or barrier/complex stability.
items.expected: The report gives a data-supported n-dependent comparison without assuming a mechanism beforehand.

items.statement: Stable hydrated reaction complexes and internal barriers can reduce conversion relative to association-limit behavior.
items.expected: The kinetic interpretation links computed candidate properties to relative hydrated-versus-bare behavior and states scope.
